subject: barrel ownership clarification
fact: Zephyr explains that the barrel wasn’t his for the taking, that drinking the barrel requires opening it up and drinking from it, and that stealing is wrong.

subject: dryad moral realization
fact: Well, I didn’t want to steal. I was just so upset.
